shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular slab/pillar face
animal or human figures shown in profile
repeated small dot/bead-like elements arranged in rows to fill an area
horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper part
justification: Both are low-relief surfaces carrying profile figures and rows of repeated small units (the beaded rows of hair/beard in B, the row of repeated animals and zigzag band in A), which is a very generic correspondence. Otherwise the content differs entirely: A shows a stacked register composition of schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds with long necks, a snake-like descending form) with no human protagonist, while B is a single large naturalistic human bust in profile with elaborate headgear, earring and patterned garment filling the whole field.
